From b084403cfc3295b59a1b6bcc94efaf870fc3c2c9 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Daeho Jeong <daehojeong@google.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Apr 2024 16:34:11 -0700
Subject: [PATCH] f2fs: write missing last sum blk of file pinning section

While do not allocating a new section in advance for file pinning area, I
missed that we should write the sum block for the last segment of a file
pinning section.

Fixes: 9703d69d9d15 ("f2fs: support file pinning for zoned devices")
Signed-off-by: Daeho Jeong <daehojeong@google.com>
Reviewed-by: Chao Yu <chao@kernel.org>
Signed-off-by: Jaegeuk Kim <jaegeuk@kernel.org>

diff --git a/fs/f2fs/segment.c b/fs/f2fs/segment.c
index 4fd76e867e0a..6474b7338e81 100644
--- a/fs/f2fs/segment.c
+++ b/fs/f2fs/segment.c
@@ -3559,6 +3559,8 @@ int f2fs_allocate_data_block(struct f2fs_sb_info *sbi, struct page *page,
 	if (segment_full) {
 		if (type == CURSEG_COLD_DATA_PINNED &&
 		    !((curseg->segno + 1) % sbi->segs_per_sec)) {
+			write_sum_page(sbi, curseg->sum_blk,
+					GET_SUM_BLOCK(sbi, curseg->segno));
 			reset_curseg_fields(curseg);
 			goto skip_new_segment;
 		}
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `fs/f2fs/segment.c`**
   - A new line of code was added to the `f2fs_allocate_data_block` function. Specifically, when the current segment is full and the type is `CURSEG_COLD_DATA_PINNED`, the function now calls `write_sum_page` to write the summary block for the last segment of the file pinning section. This is done before resetting the current segment fields and skipping to the new segment allocation.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modification addresses a bug related to file pinning in the F2FS (Flash-Friendly File System) by ensuring that the summary block for the last segment of a file pinning section is written correctly. This change is directly linked to the previous commit identified by the fix reference (`9703d69d9d15`), which introduced support for file pinning on zoned devices. The addition of the `write_sum_page` function call ensures that the summary block is not missed when the segment is full, thereby enhancing the integrity of the file pinning feature.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
if (curseg->next_blkoff >= f2fs_usable_blks_in_seg(sbi, curseg->segno))
    segment_full = true;
```
```c
if (type == CURSEG_COLD_DATA_PINNED &&
    !((curseg->segno + 1) % sbi->segs_per_sec)) {
```
Reason:
The bug occurs because when the current segment is full and a new section is not allocated in advance, the summary block for the last segment of the file pinning section is not written. This leads to incomplete data management, as the system fails to maintain the integrity of the file system's structure by not updating the necessary summary information.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
write_sum_page(sbi, curseg->sum_blk,
                GET_SUM_BLOCK(sbi, curseg->segno));
```
Reason:
The fix involves explicitly writing the summary block for the last segment of the file pinning section when the current segment is full. This ensures that the summary information is correctly updated, thereby maintaining the integrity of the file system and preventing data management issues related to the file pinning feature.
